summary: The registrant, SRIVARU Holding Ltd, filed a Form 6-K on July 13, 2026, to report a change in directors (appointment of Selvaraj Krishnan and resignation of Mohanraj Ramasamy), a change of registered agent and registered office, and an update on its financial condition stating it has been unable to raise additional capital and is evaluating all options. This is a routine current report of corporate developments and does not constitute a special situation event. No transaction terms or deal mechanics are provided, and no strategic alternative has been selected.
